deduplication.reviewed_against: Existing art-style-hub catalog names, slugs, summaries, recipe mechanisms and scene arrangements, including the full composition as well as material.
deduplication.decision: Reuse exact or synonymous existing methods. Do not collapse distinct compositions merely because they share paper, watercolor, collage or miniature media. No existing canonical style is deleted in this batch.

reused.reason: The existing method already expresses the observed scene as a deliberate fuse-bead construction. Reuse that canonical entry and register a name alias rather than add another synonymous style.

The existing travel rubber-stamp method covers the observable ink-impression direction. The video segment exposes a trigger and skill link rather than a complete independently readable prompt; no missing instructions are invented.
reused.linked_skill_status: The video showed a Lovart skill link with visually ambiguous characters; no unverified URL is asserted as an accessed source.

distinct_examples.difference: A preserved upper source and recomposed lower source-derived collage are required; exactly one realistic giant hand must physically contact a selected subject, which is removed from its former lower-panel position.

A suspended centered aged book, specified left-page handwriting and same-source right-page photograph overlay a full photographic background; a loose scrapbook page does not implement that arrangement.
A single scene-contour shallow magnet on a source-colored field does not use a round gold badge, enamel compartment outline or photograph-plus-badge page.
Paired semicircular seam notches, six-to-seven bottom holes and a separate information stub are structurally different from an evenly perforated photograph.
Equal photo and illustration halves, source-derived color, fine ink, a small isometric base and extensive lower whitespace are required; a full-canvas paper sculpture is a different composition.

The lower watercolor is an axonometric three-to-six-layer structural study with leaders, numbering and named swatches below an equal-height original photo; separate stickers or an ordinary painted horizon do not share this mechanism.
The 55% upper photograph, fibrous tear, separating blank gap, small two-to-four-ink lower screenprint and exactly one seam postmark define a particular postcard arrangement.
